narr: A strong mid-level trough of low pressure over Georgia tracked northeast into the Carolinas early on the morning of the 17th of March. At the surface, a surface low tracked northeast along the eastern Piedmont and Coastal Plain during the early morning hours. A warm front also was tied to the system. This area of low pressure provided deep lift and moisture for periods of widespread rain and some heavier storms capable of flash flooding. There was one report of flash flooding in Wake County in the morning of the 17th.
ev: The onramp from South Dawson Street to Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard was closed due to flash flooding.
lsr: ONRAMP FROM S. DAWSON ST TO MLK JR BLVD CLOSED FROM FLOODING.
